set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step 1: install nginx =="
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

echo "== step 2: layout =="

sudo -n chmod 700 /etc/nginx/ssl/ca

echo "== step 3: local CA (one-time, long-lived) =="
if [ ! -f /etc/nginx/ssl/ca/ca-key.pem ]; then
  sudo -n openssl genrsa -out /etc/nginx/ssl/ca/ca-key.pem 4096 2>/dev/null
  sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key /etc/nginx/ssl/ca/ca-key.pem -sha256 \
    -days 3650 -out /etc/nginx/ssl/ca/ca-cert.pem \
    -subj "/O=InfraSet Local CA/CN=infraset-local-ca"
  sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/nginx/ssl/ca/ca-key.pem
fi
echo "CA fingerprint:"; sudo -n openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in /etc/nginx/ssl/ca/ca-cert.pem

echo "== step 4: renewal script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert.sh >/dev/null <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
SSL_DIR=/etc/nginx/ssl
CA_KEY=$SSL_DIR/ca/ca-key.pem
CA_CERT=$SSL_DIR/ca/ca-cert.pem
CERT=$SSL_DIR/cert.pem
KEY=$SSL_DIR/key.pem
LOG=/var/log/cert-rotation/renew.log
VALID_SECONDS=300
RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECONDS=180
NODE_IP_VAL="$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')"

log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$1" >> "$LOG"; }

need_renew=1
if [ -f "$CERT" ]; then
  end_epoch=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2 | xargs -I{} date -d {} +%s)
  now_epoch=$(date +%s)
  remaining=$((end_epoch - now_epoch))
  if [ "$remaining" -gt "$RENEW_THRESHOLD_SECONDS" ]; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
  log "checked existing cert, remaining=${remaining}s"
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
  exit 0
fi

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

openssl genrsa -out "$TMP/key.pem" 2048 2>/dev/null

cat > "$TMP/san.cnf" <<EOF
[req]
distinguished_name = dn
req_extensions = ext
prompt = no
[dn]
CN = node1
[ext]
subjectAltName = DNS:node1,IP:${NODE_IP_VAL},IP:127.0.0.1
EOF

openssl req -new -key "$TMP/key.pem" -out "$TMP/csr.pem" -subj "/CN=node1" -config "$TMP/san.cnf"

SERIAL=$(date +%s)
openssl x509 -req -in "$TMP/csr.pem" -CA "$CA_CERT" -CAkey "$CA_KEY" \
  -set_serial "$SERIAL" -days $((VALID_SECONDS/86400+1)) \
  -extfile "$TMP/san.cnf" -extensions ext \
  -out "$TMP/cert.pem" 2>/dev/null

FAKE_END=$(date -u -d "+${VALID_SECONDS} seconds" +%y%m%d%H%M%SZ)
faketime_available=0

install -m 600 "$TMP/key.pem" "$SSL_DIR/key.pem.new"
install -m 644 "$TMP/cert.pem" "$SSL_DIR/cert.pem.new"
mv -f "$SSL_DIR/key.pem.new" "$KEY"
mv -f "$SSL_DIR/cert.pem.new" "$CERT"

NEW_FP=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -fingerprint -sha256)
log "renewed cert, serial=${SERIAL}, fp=${NEW_FP}"

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
  nginx -t >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl reload nginx && log "nginx reloaded"
fi
SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 750 /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert.sh
sudo -n chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert.sh

echo "== step 5: generate initial cert (short-lived, ~5 min validity to demonstrate rotation) =="
sudo -n sed -n '1,5p' /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert.sh
sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert.sh
echo "initial cert:"
sudo -n openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem -noout -subject -dates -fingerprint -sha256

echo "== step 6: nginx site config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/nginx/sites-available/node1-https >/dev/null <<'NGINX'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl default_server;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl default_server;
    server_name node1;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem;

    location / {
        return 200 "ok\n";
        add_header Content-Type text/plain;
    }
}
NGINX
sudo -n ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/node1-https /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/node1-https
sudo -n rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
sudo -n nginx -t
sudo -n systemctl enable nginx >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo -n systemctl restart nginx
sleep 1
systemctl is-active nginx

echo "== step 7: verify HTTPS works =="
curl -sk --max-time 5 "https://$NODE_IP:8443/" -o /tmp/curl1.out -w "http_code=%{http_code}\n"
cat /tmp/curl1.out

echo "== step 8: systemd timer for renewal (checks every 20s, renews when <3min remain) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Renew node1 HTTPS certificate and reload nginx
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert.sh
UNIT

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.timer >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Periodic node1 HTTPS certificate renewal check
[Timer]
OnBootSec=15s
OnUnitActiveSec=20s
AccuracySec=1s
Persistent=true
Unit=cert-renew.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now cert-renew.timer
sleep 1
systemctl is-active cert-renew.timer
systemctl list-timers cert-renew.timer --no-pager

CA_CERT=$SSL_DIR/ca/ca-cert.pem
CERT=$SSL_DIR/cert.pem

  end_epoch=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -enddate | cut -d= -f2 | xargs -I{} date -u -d {} +%s)

    need_renew=0

  exit 0

trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

openssl genrsa -out "$TMP/key.pem" 2048 2>/dev/null

cat > "$TMP/san.cnf" <<EOF
[req]
distinguished_name = dn
req_extensions = ext
prompt = no
[dn]
CN = node1
[ext]
subjectAltName = DNS:node1,IP:${NODE_IP_VAL},IP:127.0.0.1

FAKE_DATE=$(date -u -d "@$FAKE_EPOCH" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

  -extfile "$TMP/san.cnf" -extensions ext \
  -out "$TMP/cert.pem" 2>/dev/null

install -m 644 "$TMP/cert.pem" "$SSL_DIR/cert.pem.new"
mv -f "$SSL_DIR/key.pem.new" "$KEY"
mv -f "$SSL_DIR/cert.pem.new" "$CERT"
